```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(Isopair)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)

has_ggplot2 <- requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)
if (has_ggplot2) library(ggplot2)

# DT rendering helper for results='asis' chunks
# Uses renderTags() + knit_meta_add() to register JS/CSS dependencies with knitr,
# so widgets render even when they are not the last expression in a chunk.
render_dt <- function(df, caption = NULL, ...) {
  widget <- datatable(df, caption = caption, rownames = FALSE,
                      class = "compact stripe",
                      options = list(pageLength = 25, dom = 'ft'), ...)
  rendered <- htmltools::renderTags(widget)
  knitr::knit_meta_add(rendered$dependencies)
  cat(rendered$html)
  cat("\n")
}

# Caching infrastructure: wrap expensive computations with cached_compute()
cached_compute <- function(key, expr, cache_dir = file.path(data_dir, "analysis_cache"),
                           force_recompute = FALSE) {
  dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  cache_file <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0(key, ".rds"))
  if (!force_recompute && file.exists(cache_file)) {
    return(readRDS(cache_file))
  }
  result <- force(expr)
  saveRDS(result, cache_file)
  result
}

# Utility functions
ct_to_label <- function(ct) tolower(gsub("_", "", ct))

evt_types <- c("Alt_TSS", "Alt_TES", "A5SS", "A3SS", "SE",
               "Missing_Internal", "IR", "IR_diff",
               "Partial_IR_5", "Partial_IR_3")

compute_event_freq <- function(profiles) {
  n_pairs <- nrow(profiles)
  n_pir5 <- sum(sapply(profiles$detailed_events, function(de)
    any(de$event_type == "Partial_IR_5")))
  n_pir3 <- sum(sapply(profiles$detailed_events, function(de)
    any(de$event_type == "Partial_IR_3")))
  counts <- c(sum(profiles$tss_changed), sum(profiles$tes_changed),
              sum(profiles$n_a5ss > 0), sum(profiles$n_a3ss > 0),
              sum(profiles$n_se > 0), sum(profiles$n_missing_internal > 0),
              sum(profiles$n_ir > 0), sum(profiles$n_ir_diff > 0),
              n_pir5, n_pir3)
  data.frame(event_type = evt_types,
             n_pairs_with_event = counts,
             pct_of_pairs = round(100 * counts / n_pairs, 1))
}

# Display labels: internal c2/c4 → user-facing NMD/Control
comp_label <- function(comp) {
  switch(toupper(comp), C2 = "NMD", C4 = "Control", toupper(comp))
}

parse_key <- function(key) {
  parts <- strsplit(key, "_")[[1]]
  list(comp = comp_label(parts[1]),
       ct = paste(parts[-1], collapse = "_"))
}

# Count CDS bp in the comparator isoform upstream (5') of the first frameshift boundary.
# Used to determine how much of the protein is conserved vs novel after a frameshift.
count_conserved_cds_bp <- function(comp_id, fs_boundary, strand, cds_df, str_df) {
  cds_row <- cds_df[cds_df$isoform_id == comp_id, ]
  str_row <- str_df[str_df$isoform_id == comp_id, ]
  if (nrow(cds_row) == 0 || nrow(str_row) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  cds_start <- cds_row$cds_start[1]
  cds_stop  <- cds_row$cds_stop[1]
  orf_len   <- cds_row$orf_length[1]
  e_starts  <- str_row$exon_starts[[1]]
  e_ends    <- str_row$exon_ends[[1]]

  # Order exons 5'→3'
  if (strand == "-") {
    ord <- order(e_starts, decreasing = TRUE)
  } else {
    ord <- order(e_starts)
  }
  e_starts <- e_starts[ord]
  e_ends   <- e_ends[ord]

  conserved <- 0L
  for (i in seq_along(e_starts)) {
    es <- e_starts[i]
    ee <- e_ends[i]
    # Intersect exon with CDS range
    cs <- max(es, cds_start)
    ce <- min(ee, cds_stop)
    if (cs > ce) next  # No CDS overlap

    if (strand == "+") {
      if (fs_boundary <= cs) break
      if (fs_boundary >= ce) {
        conserved <- conserved + (ce - cs + 1L)
      } else {
        conserved <- conserved + (fs_boundary - cs)
        break
      }
    } else {
      if (fs_boundary >= ce) break
      if (fs_boundary <= cs) {
        conserved <- conserved + (ce - cs + 1L)
      } else {
        conserved <- conserved + (ce - fs_boundary)
        break
      }
    }
  }
  conserved <- min(conserved, orf_len)
  as.integer(conserved)
}

# Build frame walk summary row for any profile key
# Restrict frame walk summary to pairs with coding references (frame_resolved not NA)
build_fw_row <- function(key) {
  fw <- set_results[[key]]$frame_walk
  if (is.null(fw) || is.null(fw$profile_summary) || nrow(fw$profile_summary) == 0) return(NULL)
  ps <- fw$profile_summary
  # Restrict to coding pairs: frame_resolved is NA when reference is non-coding
  ps <- ps[!is.na(ps$frame_resolved), ]
  if (nrow(ps) == 0) return(NULL)
  n <- nrow(ps)
  has_shift <- ps$n_frameshifts > 0
  n_shift <- sum(has_shift, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_unres <- sum(has_shift & ps$frame_resolved == FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_comp <- sum(ps$n_compensatory > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble::tibble(
    n_pairs = n,
    median_splice_groups = round(median(ps$n_splice_groups, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    n_with_frameshift = n_shift,
    pct_with_frameshift = round(100 * n_shift / n, 1),
    n_unresolved = n_unres,
    pct_unresolved = round(100 * n_unres / n, 1),
    n_compensated = n_comp,
    pct_compensated = if (n_shift > 0) round(100 * n_comp / n_shift, 1) else 0,
    median_pct_orf_frameshifted = round(
      median(ps$pct_orf_frameshifted[ps$n_frameshifts > 0], na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  )
}

# Helper functions for rendering/computing per-cell-type results
# Used by both the all_samples main body and the per-CT tabbed section
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1. Render event frequency table + summary stats
render_event_frequency <- function(ct) {
  cps <- cross_results[[ct]]
  if (is.null(cps)) return(invisible(NULL))
  ef <- cps$event_frequency
  if (is.null(ef) || isTRUE(ef$skipped)) return(invisible(NULL))

  ef_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ef$per_event, function(e) {
    dir_label <- gsub("enriched in A", "enriched in NMD",
                 gsub("enriched in B", "enriched in Control", e$direction))
    data.frame(
      event_type = e$event_type,
      NMD_n = e$count_a, NMD_pct = round(100 * e$count_a / e$n_a, 1),
      Ctrl_n = e$count_b, Ctrl_pct = round(100 * e$count_b / e$n_b, 1),
      OR = round(e$odds_ratio, 2),
      adj_p = e$adj_p_value,
      direction = dir_label
    )
  }))
  render_dt(ef_df, caption = sprintf("Event Type Prevalence: NMD vs Control — %s", ct))

  ec <- cps$event_count
  if (!is.null(ec) && !isTRUE(ec$skipped))
    cat(sprintf("Event count: Wilcoxon p = %s, d = %.3f (NMD median = %.0f, Control = %.0f)\n\n",
                format(ec$p_value, digits = 3), ec$cliffs_d, ec$median_a, ec$median_b))

  pc <- cps$profile_categories
  if (!is.null(pc) && !isTRUE(pc$skipped))
    cat(sprintf("Profile categories: Chi-square p = %s, V = %.3f\n\n",
                format(pc$p_value, digits = 3), pc$cramers_v))

  cooc_cps <- cps$cooccurrence
  if (!is.null(cooc_cps) && !isTRUE(cooc_cps$skipped))
    cat(sprintf("Co-occurrence structure is shared between NMD and Control (r = %.3f).\n\n",
                cooc_cps$correlation))

  pt <- cps$paired_tests
  if (!is.null(pt) && !isTRUE(pt$skipped)) {
    cat(sprintf("Paired analysis (%d gene-matched pairs): Wilcoxon p = %s; sign test: %.0f%% of genes have more events in NMD (p = %s)\n\n",
                pt$n_genes_overlap,
                format(pt$paired_wilcox$p_value, digits = 3),
                pt$sign_test$pct_a_more,
                format(pt$sign_test$p_value, digits = 3)))
  }
}

# 2. Compute structural divergence table
# Per-region length differences from direct isoform pair comparisons (ref - comp)
compute_divergence_row <- function(ct) {
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
  c2_key <- paste0("c2_", ct_label)
  c4_key <- paste0("c4_", ct_label)
  if (!c2_key %in% names(set_results) || !c4_key %in% names(set_results)) return(NULL)
  div_c2 <- set_results[[c2_key]]$divergence
  div_c4 <- set_results[[c4_key]]$divergence
  if (is.null(div_c2) || nrow(div_c2) == 0 || is.null(div_c4) || nrow(div_c4) == 0) return(NULL)

  regions <- c("exonic_bp" = "Overall Exonic",
               "utr5_bp"   = "5' UTR",
               "cds_bp"    = "CDS",
               "utr3_bp"   = "3' UTR")
  diff_cols <- paste0(names(regions), "_diff")

  div_tbl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(regions), function(i) {
    col <- diff_cols[i]
    ref_col <- paste0(names(regions)[i], "_ref")
    comp_col <- paste0(names(regions)[i], "_comp")

    # For overall exonic, use all pairs; for UTR/CDS, restrict to pairs
    # where both isoforms have >0 bp in that region
    if (col == "exonic_bp_diff") {
      c2_vals <- div_c2[[col]]
      c4_vals <- div_c4[[col]]
    } else {
      c2_mask <- div_c2[[ref_col]] > 0 & div_c2[[comp_col]] > 0
      c4_mask <- div_c4[[ref_col]] > 0 & div_c4[[comp_col]] > 0
      c2_vals <- div_c2[[col]][c2_mask]
      c4_vals <- div_c4[[col]][c4_mask]
    }

    wt_r <- if (length(c2_vals) > 1 && length(c4_vals) > 1)
      tryCatch(wilcox.test(c2_vals, c4_vals), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL

    data.frame(
      region = regions[i],
      NMD_n = length(c2_vals),
      NMD_median_diff = round(median(c2_vals, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
      NMD_mean_diff = round(mean(c2_vals, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
      NMD_pct_comp_shorter = round(100 * mean(c2_vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      Ctrl_n = length(c4_vals),
      Ctrl_median_diff = round(median(c4_vals, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
      Ctrl_mean_diff = round(mean(c4_vals, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
      Ctrl_pct_comp_shorter = round(100 * mean(c4_vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      wilcox_p = if (!is.null(wt_r)) wt_r$p.value else NA_real_
    )
  }))
  rownames(div_tbl) <- NULL
  div_tbl
}

# 3. Compute gain/loss balance row
compute_gain_loss_row <- function(ct) {
  cps <- cross_results[[ct]]
  if (is.null(cps)) return(NULL)
  gl <- cps$gain_loss
  if (is.null(gl) || isTRUE(gl$skipped)) return(NULL)
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
  c2_key <- paste0("c2_", ct_label)
  c4_key <- paste0("c4_", ct_label)
  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
    NMD_med_net_bp = round(median(set_results[[c2_key]]$profiles$net_bp), 0),
    Ctrl_med_net_bp = round(median(set_results[[c4_key]]$profiles$net_bp), 0),
    wilcox_p = gl$p_value,
    cliffs_d = round(gl$cliffs_d, 3)
  )
}

# 4. Compute gain/loss direction by event type table
compute_gain_loss_direction <- function(ct) {
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
  c2_key <- paste0("c2_", ct_label)
  c4_key <- paste0("c4_", ct_label)
  if (!c2_key %in% names(set_results) || !c4_key %in% names(set_results)) return(NULL)

  events_c2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(set_results[[c2_key]]$profiles$detailed_events)
  events_c4 <- dplyr::bind_rows(set_results[[c4_key]]$profiles$detailed_events)

  if (nrow(events_c2) == 0 || nrow(events_c4) == 0) return(NULL)
  dir_comp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
    unique(c(events_c2$event_type, events_c4$event_type)), function(et) {
      e2 <- events_c2[events_c2$event_type == et, ]
      e4 <- events_c4[events_c4$event_type == et, ]
      g2 <- sum(e2$direction == "GAIN"); l2 <- sum(e2$direction == "LOSS")
      g4 <- sum(e4$direction == "GAIN"); l4 <- sum(e4$direction == "LOSS")
      ft <- if ((g2 + l2) > 0 && (g4 + l4) > 0)
        tryCatch(fisher.test(matrix(c(g2, l2, g4, l4), nrow = 2)), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
      data.frame(
        event_type = et,
        NMD_gain = g2, NMD_loss = l2,
        NMD_pct_gain = round(100 * g2 / max(g2+l2, 1), 1),
        Ctrl_gain = g4, Ctrl_loss = l4,
        Ctrl_pct_gain = round(100 * g4 / max(g4+l4, 1), 1),
        fisher_p = if (!is.null(ft)) ft$p.value else NA_real_
      )
  }))
  dir_comp$adj_p <- p.adjust(dir_comp$fisher_p, "BH")
  dir_comp
}

# 5. Compute IR individual types table
compute_ir_individual <- function(ct) {
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
  c2_key <- paste0("c2_", ct_label)
  c4_key <- paste0("c4_", ct_label)
  if (!c2_key %in% names(set_results) || !c4_key %in% names(set_results)) return(NULL)
  # IR_diff aggregates IR_diff_5, IR_diff_3, IR_diff_5_3
  ir_types <- c("IR", "IR_diff", "Partial_IR_5", "Partial_IR_3")

  events_c2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(set_results[[c2_key]]$profiles$detailed_events)
  events_c4 <- dplyr::bind_rows(set_results[[c4_key]]$profiles$detailed_events)

  ir_detail <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ir_types, function(et) {
    if (et == "IR_diff") {
      e2 <- events_c2[grepl("^IR_diff", events_c2$event_type), ]
      e4 <- events_c4[grepl("^IR_diff", events_c4$event_type), ]
    } else {
      e2 <- events_c2[events_c2$event_type == et, ]
      e4 <- events_c4[events_c4$event_type == et, ]
    }
    g2 <- sum(e2$direction == "GAIN"); l2 <- sum(e2$direction == "LOSS")
    g4 <- sum(e4$direction == "GAIN"); l4 <- sum(e4$direction == "LOSS")
    ft <- if ((g2 + l2) > 0 && (g4 + l4) > 0)
      tryCatch(fisher.test(matrix(c(g2, l2, g4, l4), nrow = 2)), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL
    data.frame(
      event_type = et,
      NMD_gain = g2, NMD_loss = l2, NMD_total = g2 + l2,
      NMD_pct_gain = round(100 * g2 / max(g2 + l2, 1), 1),
      Ctrl_gain = g4, Ctrl_loss = l4, Ctrl_total = g4 + l4,
      Ctrl_pct_gain = round(100 * g4 / max(g4 + l4, 1), 1),
      fisher_p = if (!is.null(ft)) ft$p.value else NA_real_
    )
  }))
  ir_detail$adj_p <- p.adjust(ir_detail$fisher_p, "BH")
  ir_detail
}

# 6. Compute cumulative IR burden row
compute_ir_cumulative_row <- function(ct) {
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
  c2_key <- paste0("c2_", ct_label)
  c4_key <- paste0("c4_", ct_label)
  if (!c2_key %in% names(set_results) || !c4_key %in% names(set_results)) return(NULL)
  ir_types <- c("IR", "IR_diff", "Partial_IR_5", "Partial_IR_3")

  events_c2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(set_results[[c2_key]]$profiles$detailed_events)
  events_c4 <- dplyr::bind_rows(set_results[[c4_key]]$profiles$detailed_events)
  ir_c2 <- events_c2[events_c2$event_type %in% ir_types, ]
  ir_c4 <- events_c4[events_c4$event_type %in% ir_types, ]

  n_c2 <- nrow(set_results[[c2_key]]$profiles)
  n_c4 <- nrow(set_results[[c4_key]]$profiles)

  ir_per_pair_c2 <- sapply(set_results[[c2_key]]$profiles$detailed_events, function(de)
    sum(de$event_type %in% ir_types))
  ir_per_pair_c4 <- sapply(set_results[[c4_key]]$profiles$detailed_events, function(de)
    sum(de$event_type %in% ir_types))

  wt <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(ir_per_pair_c2, ir_per_pair_c4), error = function(e) NULL)

  g2 <- sum(ir_c2$direction == "GAIN"); l2 <- sum(ir_c2$direction == "LOSS")
  g4 <- sum(ir_c4$direction == "GAIN"); l4 <- sum(ir_c4$direction == "LOSS")
  ft <- if ((g2 + l2) > 0 && (g4 + l4) > 0)
    tryCatch(fisher.test(matrix(c(g2, l2, g4, l4), nrow = 2)), error = function(e) NULL) else NULL

  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
    NMD_total_ir = nrow(ir_c2),
    NMD_per_pair = round(nrow(ir_c2) / n_c2, 2),
    NMD_pct_gain = round(100 * g2 / max(g2 + l2, 1), 1),
    Ctrl_total_ir = nrow(ir_c4),
    Ctrl_per_pair = round(nrow(ir_c4) / n_c4, 2),
    Ctrl_pct_gain = round(100 * g4 / max(g4 + l4, 1), 1),
    count_wilcox_p = if (!is.null(wt)) wt$p.value else NA_real_,
    dir_fisher_p = if (!is.null(ft)) ft$p.value else NA_real_
  )
}

# 7. Compute PTC rates row
compute_ptc_rates_row <- function(ct) {
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
  c2_key <- paste0("c2_", ct_label)
  c4_key <- paste0("c4_", ct_label)
  if (!c2_key %in% names(set_results) || !c4_key %in% names(set_results)) return(NULL)

  coding_ids <- cds$isoform_id[cds$coding_status == "coding"]

  p_c2 <- set_results[[c2_key]]$profiles
  cod_c2 <- p_c2[p_c2$reference_isoform_id %in% coding_ids &
                   p_c2$comparator_isoform_id %in% coding_ids, ]
  p_c4 <- set_results[[c4_key]]$profiles
  cod_c4 <- p_c4[p_c4$reference_isoform_id %in% coding_ids &
                   p_c4$comparator_isoform_id %in% coding_ids, ]
  if (nrow(cod_c2) == 0 || nrow(cod_c4) == 0) return(NULL)

  ptc_c2 <- sum(cod_c2$comparator_isoform_id %in% ptc$isoform_id[ptc$has_ptc == TRUE])
  ptc_c4 <- sum(cod_c4$comparator_isoform_id %in% ptc$isoform_id[ptc$has_ptc == TRUE])
  n_c2 <- nrow(cod_c2); n_c4 <- nrow(cod_c4)

  ft <- tryCatch({
    mat <- matrix(c(ptc_c2, n_c2 - ptc_c2, ptc_c4, n_c4 - ptc_c4), nrow = 2)
    fisher.test(mat)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
    n_coding_pairs = n_c2,
    NMD_comp_ptc_n = ptc_c2,
    NMD_comp_ptc_pct = round(100 * ptc_c2 / n_c2, 1),
    Ctrl_comp_ptc_n = ptc_c4,
    Ctrl_comp_ptc_pct = round(100 * ptc_c4 / n_c4, 1),
    fisher_OR = if (!is.null(ft)) round(ft$estimate, 2) else NA_real_,
    p_value = if (!is.null(ft)) ft$p.value else NA_real_
  )
}

# 8. Compute frame category count rows
compute_frame_category_rows <- function(ct) {
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
  c2_key <- paste0("c2_", ct_label)
  c4_key <- paste0("c4_", ct_label)
  if (!c2_key %in% names(set_results) || !c4_key %in% names(set_results)) return(NULL)
  fc_c2 <- set_results[[c2_key]]$frame_comp
  fc_c4 <- set_results[[c4_key]]$frame_comp
  if (is.null(fc_c2) || is.null(fc_c4)) return(NULL)
  ps_c2 <- fc_c2$pair_summary
  ps_c4 <- fc_c4$pair_summary

  cats <- c("same_start_in_frame", "same_start_frameshift",
            "diff_start_same_frame", "diff_start_diff_frame",
            "diff_start_diff_frame_with_frameshift",
            "non_coding", "no_shared_cds")
  do.call(rbind, lapply(cats, function(cat) {
    data.frame(
      cell_type = ct,
      frame_category = cat,
      NMD_n = sum(ps_c2$frame_category == cat),
      NMD_pct = round(100 * sum(ps_c2$frame_category == cat) / nrow(ps_c2), 1),
      Ctrl_n = sum(ps_c4$frame_category == cat),
      Ctrl_pct = round(100 * sum(ps_c4$frame_category == cat) / nrow(ps_c4), 1)
    )
  }))
}

# 9. Compute PTC mechanism rows
compute_ptc_mechanism_rows <- function(ct) {
  coding_cats <- c("same_start_in_frame", "same_start_frameshift",
                   "diff_start_same_frame", "diff_start_diff_frame",
                   "diff_start_diff_frame_with_frameshift")
  ptc_pos_ids <- ptc$isoform_id[ptc$has_ptc == TRUE]
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)

  mech <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("c2", "c4"), function(comp) {
    key <- paste0(comp, "_", ct_label)
    if (!key %in% names(set_results)) return(NULL)
    fc <- set_results[[key]]$frame_comp
    if (is.null(fc) || is.null(fc$pair_summary)) return(NULL)
    ps <- fc$pair_summary
    ps_coding <- ps[ps$frame_category %in% coding_cats, ]
    ps_ptc <- ps_coding[ps_coding$comparator_isoform_id %in% ptc_pos_ids, ]
    n_ptc_total <- nrow(ps_ptc)

    do.call(rbind, lapply(coding_cats, function(cat) {
      n_cat <- sum(ps_ptc$frame_category == cat)
      data.frame(
        cell_type = ct, comparison = comp_label(comp),
        frame_category = cat,
        n_ptc = n_cat, ptc_total = n_ptc_total,
        pct_of_ptc = round(100 * n_cat / max(n_ptc_total, 1), 1)
      )
    }))
  }))

  # Also compute frameshift enrichment test
  c2_key <- paste0("c2_", ct_label)
  c4_key <- paste0("c4_", ct_label)
  fs_test <- NULL
  if (c2_key %in% names(set_results) && c4_key %in% names(set_results)) {
    fc_c2 <- set_results[[c2_key]]$frame_comp
    fc_c4 <- set_results[[c4_key]]$frame_comp
    if (!is.null(fc_c2) && !is.null(fc_c4)) {
      ps_c2 <- fc_c2$pair_summary; ps_c4 <- fc_c4$pair_summary
      n_ss_fs_c2 <- sum(ps_c2$frame_category == "same_start_frameshift")
      n_ss_if_c2 <- sum(ps_c2$frame_category == "same_start_in_frame")
      n_ss_fs_c4 <- sum(ps_c4$frame_category == "same_start_frameshift")
      n_ss_if_c4 <- sum(ps_c4$frame_category == "same_start_in_frame")
      fi <- tryCatch(
        fisher.test(matrix(c(n_ss_fs_c2, n_ss_if_c2, n_ss_fs_c4, n_ss_if_c4), nrow = 2)),
        error = function(e) NULL)
      fs_test <- data.frame(
        cell_type = ct,
        NMD_ss_total = n_ss_fs_c2 + n_ss_if_c2,
        NMD_fs_pct = round(100 * n_ss_fs_c2 / max(n_ss_fs_c2 + n_ss_if_c2, 1), 1),
        Ctrl_ss_total = n_ss_fs_c4 + n_ss_if_c4,
        Ctrl_fs_pct = round(100 * n_ss_fs_c4 / max(n_ss_fs_c4 + n_ss_if_c4, 1), 1),
        OR = if (!is.null(fi)) round(fi$estimate, 2) else NA_real_,
        p_value = if (!is.null(fi)) fi$p.value else NA_real_
      )
    }
  }
  list(mechanism = mech, fs_test = fs_test)
}

# 10. Compute frameshift outcome rows
compute_frameshift_outcome_rows <- function(ct) {
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
  rows <- list()
  for (comp in c("c2", "c4")) {
    key <- paste0(comp, "_", ct_label)
    if (!key %in% names(set_results)) next
    fc <- set_results[[key]]$frame_comp
    if (is.null(fc) || is.null(fc$pair_summary)) next
    ps <- fc$pair_summary
    ss <- ps[ps$frame_category %in% c("same_start_in_frame", "same_start_frameshift"), ]
    n_same_start <- nrow(ss)
    n_in_frame <- sum(ss$frame_category == "same_start_in_frame")
    fs_pairs <- ss[ss$frame_category == "same_start_frameshift", ]
    n_fs_ptc <- 0L; n_fs_stop_last <- 0L; n_fs_other <- 0L
    if (nrow(fs_pairs) > 0) {
      fs_ptc <- merge(fs_pairs, ptc[, c("isoform_id", "has_ptc", "stop_in_last_exon")],
                      by.x = "comparator_isoform_id", by.y = "isoform_id", all.x = TRUE)
      n_fs_ptc       <- sum(fs_ptc$has_ptc == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
      no_ptc_mask    <- !is.na(fs_ptc$has_ptc) & fs_ptc$has_ptc == FALSE
      n_fs_stop_last <- sum(no_ptc_mask & fs_ptc$stop_in_last_exon == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
      n_fs_other     <- sum(no_ptc_mask & (is.na(fs_ptc$stop_in_last_exon) |
                                            fs_ptc$stop_in_last_exon == FALSE))
    }
    rows[[comp]] <- data.frame(
      cell_type = ct, comparison = comp_label(comp),
      n_same_start = n_same_start, n_in_frame = n_in_frame,
      n_fs_ptc = n_fs_ptc, n_fs_stop_last = n_fs_stop_last, n_fs_other = n_fs_other
    )
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

# 11. Compute frame-PTC cross-reference rows
compute_frame_ptc_xref_rows <- function(ct) {
  coding_cats <- c("same_start_in_frame", "same_start_frameshift",
                   "diff_start_same_frame", "diff_start_diff_frame",
                   "diff_start_diff_frame_with_frameshift")
  ptc_pos_ids <- ptc$isoform_id[ptc$has_ptc == TRUE]
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)

  do.call(rbind, lapply(c("c2", "c4"), function(comp) {
    key <- paste0(comp, "_", ct_label)
    if (!key %in% names(set_results)) return(NULL)
    fc <- set_results[[key]]$frame_comp
    if (is.null(fc) || is.null(fc$pair_summary)) return(NULL)
    ps <- fc$pair_summary

    do.call(rbind, lapply(coding_cats, function(cat) {
      cat_pairs <- ps[ps$frame_category == cat, ]
      n_cat <- nrow(cat_pairs)
      n_ptc <- sum(cat_pairs$comparator_isoform_id %in% ptc_pos_ids)
      data.frame(cell_type = ct, comparison = comp_label(comp),
                 frame_category = cat, n_pairs = n_cat, n_ptc = n_ptc,
                 ptc_pct = round(100 * n_ptc / max(n_cat, 1), 1))
    }))
  }))
}

# 12. Render frame walk by event type for one ct
render_frame_walk <- function(ct) {
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
  c2_key <- paste0("c2_", ct_label)
  c4_key <- paste0("c4_", ct_label)
  if (!c2_key %in% names(set_results)) return(invisible(NULL))

  fw_tables <- list()
  for (comp in c("c2", "c4")) {
    key <- paste0(comp, "_", ct_label)
    if (!key %in% names(set_results)) next
    fw <- set_results[[key]]$frame_walk
    if (is.null(fw) || nrow(fw$events) == 0L) next
    fw_evts <- fw$events
    fw_tables[[comp]] <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(fw_evts$event_type), function(et) {
      e <- fw_evts[fw_evts$event_type == et, ]
      data.frame(event_type = et,
                 n_cds_events = nrow(e),
                 pct_frameshift = round(100 * sum(e$is_frameshift) / nrow(e), 1),
                 pct_compensatory = round(100 * sum(e$is_compensatory) / nrow(e), 1))
    }))
  }

  if (length(fw_tables) == 2) {
    fw_merged <- merge(fw_tables[["c2"]], fw_tables[["c4"]],
                       by = "event_type", suffixes = c("_NMD", "_Ctrl"), all = TRUE)
    render_dt(fw_merged, caption = sprintf("Frame Walk by Event Type: NMD vs Control — %s", ct))
  } else if ("c2" %in% names(fw_tables)) {
    render_dt(fw_tables[["c2"]], caption = sprintf("Frame Walk by Event Type: NMD — %s", ct))
  }
}

# 13. Compute novel protein metrics for one ct (C4 same_start_frameshift, no PTC)
compute_novel_protein <- function(ct) {
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
  c4_key <- paste0("c4_", ct_label)
  if (!c4_key %in% names(set_results)) return(NULL)
  fc <- set_results[[c4_key]]$frame_comp
  if (is.null(fc)) return(NULL)

  cached_compute(paste0("novel_protein_c4_v2_", ct_label), {
    ps <- fc$pair_summary
    rd <- fc$region_detail
    fs_pairs <- ps[ps$frame_category == "same_start_frameshift", ]
    if (nrow(fs_pairs) == 0) return(NULL)
    fs_merged <- merge(fs_pairs,
                       ptc[, c("isoform_id", "has_ptc", "orf_length")],
                       by.x = "comparator_isoform_id", by.y = "isoform_id", all.x = TRUE)
    fs_merged <- fs_merged[!is.na(fs_merged$has_ptc) & fs_merged$has_ptc == FALSE, ]
    if (nrow(fs_merged) == 0) return(NULL)
    strand_lookup <- setNames(cds$strand, cds$isoform_id)
    results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(fs_merged)), function(i) {
      row <- fs_merged[i, ]
      comp_id <- row$comparator_isoform_id
      ref_id  <- row$reference_isoform_id
      s <- strand_lookup[comp_id]
      if (is.na(s)) return(NULL)
      pair_rd <- rd[rd$reference_isoform_id == ref_id &
                    rd$comparator_isoform_id == comp_id, ]
      if (nrow(pair_rd) == 0) return(NULL)
      div_regions <- pair_rd[pair_rd$ref_phase_at_start != pair_rd$comp_phase_at_start, ]
      if (nrow(div_regions) == 0) return(NULL)
      if (s == "+") { fs_boundary <- min(div_regions$region_start)
      } else { fs_boundary <- max(div_regions$region_end) }
      conserved_bp <- count_conserved_cds_bp(comp_id, fs_boundary, s, cds, structures)
      if (is.na(conserved_bp)) return(NULL)
      comp_orf <- row$orf_length
      novel_bp <- max(0L, comp_orf - conserved_bp)
      data.frame(
        gene_id = row$gene_id, comparator_isoform_id = comp_id,
        orf_length = comp_orf, conserved_bp = conserved_bp,
        novel_bp = novel_bp, novel_aa = novel_bp / 3,
        total_aa = comp_orf / 3, pct_novel = 100 * (novel_bp / 3) / (comp_orf / 3)
      )
    })
    do.call(rbind, results)
  })
}
```

# 1. Setup

This report analyzes structural differences between isoform pairs using the Isopair package,
with NMD classification derived from **mashr** (multivariate adaptive shrinkage) differential
isoform expression results. Mashr logFC values are shrunken relative to limma, but NMD
classification uses the pre-computed `nmd_responsive` flag (adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0).
Main analyses cover all_samples (union NMD / intersection non-NMD) plus AT, DD, DO, FB, and MV.
DD_ALI is analyzed separately (Section 7) due to reversed biological patterns.

```{r load-data}
data_dir <- "data_mashr"

# Infrastructure
structures     <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "structures.rds"))
union_exons    <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "union_exons.rds"))

cds            <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "cds.rds"))
cds_exons      <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "cds_exons.rds"))
annotated_ue   <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "annotated_ue.rds"))
ptc            <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "ptc.rds"))

# Study data

sample_meta    <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "sample_metadata.rds"))
gene_map       <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "gene_map.rds"))
nmd_class      <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "nmd_classification.rds"))

# Build gene_id → gene_symbol lookup from mashr DE files

gene_symbol_lookup <- character(0)
for (de_f in list.files(de_dir_mashr, pattern = "^nmd_mashr_die_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)) {
  de_tmp <- read.csv(de_f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[, c("gene_id", "hgnc_symbol")]

# Cell types with profiles (mashr: DO included, DD_ALI excluded from main)

# Load DD_ALI profiles from original limma data directory for the DD_ALI section

cat(sprintf("Loaded %d profile sets across %d cell types (including DD_ALI from limma)\n",
            length(profiles_list), length(cell_types) + 1L))
```

```{r gene-match}
# Bidirectional gene-matching: restrict NMD and Control to the intersection of
# (gene_id, reference_isoform_id) pairs present in BOTH sets. After this step,
# every gene in NMD has a corresponding Control pair and vice versa.
gene_match_summary <- list()
# Include DD_ALI in gene-matching (loaded from limma) for the dedicated section
for (ct in unique(c(cell_types, ali_ct))) {
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
  c2_key <- paste0("c2_", ct_label)
  c4_key <- paste0("c4_", ct_label)
  if (!c2_key %in% names(profiles_list) || !c4_key %in% names(profiles_list)) next

  nmd_before <- nrow(profiles_list[[c2_key]])
  control_before <- nrow(profiles_list[[c4_key]])

  # Intersection of (gene_id, reference_isoform_id)
  c2_gene_refs <- unique(profiles_list[[c2_key]][, c("gene_id", "reference_isoform_id")])
  c4_gene_refs <- unique(profiles_list[[c4_key]][, c("gene_id", "reference_isoform_id")])
  shared_refs <- inner_join(c2_gene_refs, c4_gene_refs, by = c("gene_id", "reference_isoform_id"))

  profiles_list[[c2_key]] <- semi_join(profiles_list[[c2_key]], shared_refs,
                                        by = c("gene_id", "reference_isoform_id"))
  profiles_list[[c4_key]] <- semi_join(profiles_list[[c4_key]], shared_refs,
                                        by = c("gene_id", "reference_isoform_id"))

  gene_match_summary[[ct]] <- data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
    nmd_before = nmd_before,
    control_before = control_before,
    matched_genes = nrow(shared_refs),
    nmd_after = nrow(profiles_list[[c2_key]]),
    control_after = nrow(profiles_list[[c4_key]])
  )
}
gene_match_df <- do.call(rbind, gene_match_summary)
```

## NMD Classification

Isoforms are classified per cell type using mashr (multivariate adaptive shrinkage)
differential isoform expression results. NMD-sensitive isoforms are identified by the
pre-computed `nmd_responsive` flag (adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0, with mashr-shrunken
effect sizes). Non-NMD: adj.P.Val > 0.50 (no evidence of NMD regulation). Note: mashr
logFC values are shrunken relative to limma, but the NMD/non-NMD classification thresholds
are identical.

**Columns:** **cell_type** = cell type used for DE testing; **n_nmd** = number of isoforms classified as NMD-sensitive in that cell type; **n_non_nmd** = number of isoforms classified as non-NMD.

```{r nmd-classification-table, results='asis'}
render_dt(nmd_summary[nmd_summary$cell_type == "all_samples", ],
          caption = "NMD Classification Summary (all_samples)")
```

## Gene-Matching Detail

To enable paired NMD vs Control comparisons, we restrict both sets to genes where the same
reference isoform appears in both NMD and Control pairs. This ensures that any differences
between NMD and Control comparators are not confounded by different reference isoforms or gene sets.

**Columns:** **nmd_before/control_before** = pair counts before matching; **matched_genes** = genes with shared (gene_id, reference_isoform_id) in both sets; **nmd_after/control_after** = pair counts after restricting to matched genes.

```{r gene-matching-table, results='asis'}
render_dt(gene_match_df[gene_match_df$cell_type == "all_samples", ],
          caption = "Gene-Matching Summary (all_samples)")
```

## Profile Sets (after gene-matching)

```{r profile-sets-compute}
# Count splice events per pair: independent splicing decisions, computed by
# grouping non-terminal events that share a splice junction (union-find).
# A single splice event (one donor/acceptor choice) can produce multiple
# sequence events (e.g., skipping 3 exons = 1 splice event, 3 sequence events).
count_splice_events <- function(events) {
  if (is.null(events) || nrow(events) == 0) return(0L)
  # Exclude terminal events — these are transcription boundary differences, not splicing
  splice_types <- c("A5SS", "A3SS", "SE", "Missing_Internal", "IR",
                     "IR_diff", "IR_diff_5", "IR_diff_3", "IR_diff_5_3",
                     "Partial_IR_5", "Partial_IR_3")
  se <- events[events$event_type %in% splice_types, ]
  n <- nrow(se)
  if (n == 0L) return(0L)
  if (n == 1L) return(1L)

  # Union-find: group events sharing a splice junction
  parent <- seq_len(n)
  find <- function(x) {
    while (parent[x] != x) { parent[x] <<- parent[parent[x]]; x <- parent[x] }
    x
  }
  union_nodes <- function(a, b) {
    ra <- find(a); rb <- find(b)
    if (ra != rb) parent[ra] <<- rb
  }

  parse_jxns <- function(jxn_str) {
    if (is.na(jxn_str) || jxn_str == "") return(character(0))
    unlist(strsplit(jxn_str, ","))
  }

  jxn_map <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    all_jxns <- unique(c(
      parse_jxns(se$ref_junctions[i]),
      parse_jxns(se$comp_junctions[i])
    ))
    for (jxn in all_jxns) {
      if (jxn %in% names(jxn_map)) union_nodes(i, jxn_map[[jxn]])
      jxn_map[[jxn]] <- i
    }
  }
  # Events with no junctions (empty ref_junctions AND comp_junctions) each form their own group
  length(unique(vapply(seq_len(n), find, integer(1))))
}

prof_overview <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(profiles_list), function(key) {
  p <- profiles_list[[key]]
  parts <- strsplit(key, "_")[[1]]

  # Per-pair splice event counts
  splice_events_per_pair <- vapply(p$detailed_events, count_splice_events, integer(1))

  data.frame(comparison = comp_label(parts[1]),
             cell_type = paste(parts[-1], collapse = "_"),
             n_profiles = nrow(p),
             n_genes = n_distinct(p$gene_id),
             total_sequence_events = sum(p$n_events),
             mean_sequence_events = round(mean(p$n_events), 2),
             total_splice_events = sum(splice_events_per_pair),
             mean_splice_events = round(mean(splice_events_per_pair), 2),
             pct_recon_pass = round(100 * mean(p$reconstruction_status == "PASS",
                                                na.rm = TRUE), 1))
}))
```

Each profile set represents isoform pairs analyzed for structural differences using
Isopair (`buildProfiles()` in `Isopair/R/profiles.R`; see METHODS.md §Event Detection
Algorithms). NMD pairs compare an NMD-sensitive comparator to a non-NMD reference;
Control pairs compare the next-best non-NMD isoform to the same reference.

The table reports two levels of event counting:

- A **sequence event** is an individual structural difference detected between two
  isoforms — e.g., a single skipped exon (SE), an alternative 5' splice site (A5SS),
  or a retained intron (IR). Each row in the `detailed_events` table is one sequence
  event. This is the finest-grained unit of structural difference.
- A **splice event** is an independent splicing decision — a single, different choice of
  donor and/or acceptor between the two isoforms. One splice event can produce multiple
  sequence events. For example, skipping three consecutive exons involves one splice
  decision (the donor of the upstream exon joins the acceptor of the downstream exon)
  but creates three Missing_Internal sequence events. Splice events are computed by
  grouping non-terminal sequence events that share a splice junction (union-find
  algorithm; see METHODS.md §Splice Group Assignment). Terminal events (Alt_TSS,
  Alt_TES) are excluded because they reflect transcription boundary differences, not
  splicing decisions.

**Columns:** **comparison** = NMD or Control; **cell_type** = cell type (or all_samples
for union/intersection); **n_profiles** = number of isoform pairs; **n_genes** = unique
genes represented; **total_sequence_events / mean_sequence_events** = sum and mean of
individual structural differences per pair; **total_splice_events / mean_splice_events** =
sum and mean of independent splicing decisions per pair; **pct_recon_pass** = % of pairs
where the comparator isoform can be perfectly reconstructed from the reference plus
detected events (quality control metric; 100% expected).

```{r profile-sets-table, results='asis'}
render_dt(prof_overview[prof_overview$cell_type == "allsamples", ],
          caption = "Profile Set Summary (all_samples, gene-matched)")
```

## Coding Status

NMD is a translation-dependent pathway: only protein-coding transcripts with an open reading
frame can harbour a premature termination codon. We therefore expect NMD-sensitive isoform pairs
to be overwhelmingly coding. This table characterizes the coding status of reference and
comparator isoforms in each profile set, based on SQANTI CDS annotations. A small fraction of
isoforms have unknown coding status (no CDS annotation in SQANTI); these are excluded from
downstream analyses that require reading-frame information (e.g., frameshift analysis).

```{r coding-status}
coding_tbl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(profiles_list), function(key) {
  p <- profiles_list[[key]]
  parts <- strsplit(key, "_")[[1]]
  comp <- comp_label(parts[1])
  ct <- paste(parts[-1], collapse = "_")

  ref_ids <- unique(p$reference_isoform_id)
  cmp_ids <- unique(p$comparator_isoform_id)

  ref_coding <- sum(ref_ids %in% cds$isoform_id[cds$coding_status == "coding"])
  cmp_coding <- sum(cmp_ids %in% cds$isoform_id[cds$coding_status == "coding"])

  # Pairs where both are coding
  ref_status <- cds$coding_status[match(p$reference_isoform_id, cds$isoform_id)]
  cmp_status <- cds$coding_status[match(p$comparator_isoform_id, cds$isoform_id)]
  both_coding <- sum(ref_status == "coding" & cmp_status == "coding", na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    Comparison = comp,
    Cell_Type = ct,
    N_Pairs = nrow(p),
    Ref_Coding = ref_coding,
    Ref_Pct = round(100 * ref_coding / length(ref_ids), 1),
    Comp_Coding = cmp_coding,
    Comp_Pct = round(100 * cmp_coding / length(cmp_ids), 1),
    Both_Coding = both_coding,
    Both_Pct = round(100 * both_coding / nrow(p), 1)
  )
}))
```

**Columns:** **Comparison** = NMD or Control; **Cell_Type** = cell type; **N_Pairs** = total
isoform pairs; **Ref_Coding / Ref_Pct** = number and percentage of unique reference isoforms
with a CDS annotation; **Comp_Coding / Comp_Pct** = same for comparator isoforms;
**Both_Coding / Both_Pct** = pairs where both reference and comparator are coding.

```{r coding-status-table, results='asis'}
render_dt(coding_tbl[coding_tbl$Cell_Type == "allsamples", ],
          caption = "Coding Status of Reference and Comparator Isoforms (all_samples)")
```

## Pair Subset Overview

The analyses in this report operate on different subsets of the isoform pair universe.
The flowcharts below show how NMD and Control pairs are progressively subdivided and
which report sections draw on each subset. Counts are for the all_samples set.

```{r pair-subset-flowchart, fig.width=16, fig.height=16}
# Combined NMD + Control pair subset flowchart
fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")

# Helper: compute subset counts for one profile set
compute_subset_counts <- function(profiles) {
  n_all <- nrow(profiles)

  ref_st <- cds$coding_status[match(profiles$reference_isoform_id, cds$isoform_id)]
  cmp_st <- cds$coding_status[match(profiles$comparator_isoform_id, cds$isoform_id)]
  n_both_coding <- sum(ref_st == "coding" & cmp_st == "coding", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_non_coding  <- n_all - n_both_coding

  fc <- tryCatch(
    compareIsoformFrames(profiles, cds_exons, cds),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(fc)) return(NULL)
  ps_ov <- fc$pair_summary

  ptc_pos_ids <- ptc$isoform_id[ptc$has_ptc == TRUE]
  count_ptc <- function(cat_name) {
    sum(ps_ov$comparator_isoform_id[ps_ov$frame_category == cat_name] %in% ptc_pos_ids)
  }

  n_ss_if  <- sum(ps_ov$frame_category == "same_start_in_frame")
  n_ss_fs  <- sum(ps_ov$frame_category == "same_start_frameshift")
  n_ds_sf  <- sum(ps_ov$frame_category == "diff_start_same_frame")
  n_ds_df  <- sum(ps_ov$frame_category == "diff_start_diff_frame")
  n_ds_dfs <- sum(ps_ov$frame_category == "diff_start_diff_frame_with_frameshift")
  n_nc     <- sum(ps_ov$frame_category == "non_coding")
  n_nsc    <- sum(ps_ov$frame_category == "no_shared_cds")

  list(
    all = n_all, coding = n_both_coding, non_coding = n_non_coding,
    same_start = n_ss_if + n_ss_fs, diff_start = n_ds_sf + n_ds_df + n_ds_dfs,
    no_shared_cds = n_nsc,
    ss_if = n_ss_if, ss_fs = n_ss_fs,
    ds_sf = n_ds_sf, ds_df = n_ds_df, ds_dfs = n_ds_dfs,
    fs_ptc = count_ptc("same_start_frameshift"),
    fs_no_ptc = n_ss_fs - count_ptc("same_start_frameshift"),
    if_ptc = count_ptc("same_start_in_frame"),
    if_no_ptc = n_ss_if - count_ptc("same_start_in_frame"),
    sf_ptc = count_ptc("diff_start_same_frame"),
    sf_no_ptc = n_ds_sf - count_ptc("diff_start_same_frame"),
    df_ptc = count_ptc("diff_start_diff_frame"),
    df_no_ptc = n_ds_df - count_ptc("diff_start_diff_frame"),
    dfs_ptc = count_ptc("diff_start_diff_frame_with_frameshift"),
    dfs_no_ptc = n_ds_dfs - count_ptc("diff_start_diff_frame_with_frameshift")
  )
}

# Helper: format a dual-count label line
dual <- function(n_nmd, n_ctrl) {
  sprintf('<font color="#d95f0e">NMD: %s</font>  |  <font color="#3182bd">Ctrl: %s</font>',
          fmt(n_nmd), fmt(n_ctrl))
}

as_c2_key <- "c2_allsamples"
as_c4_key <- "c4_allsamples"
dot_combined <- NULL

if (requireNamespace("DiagrammeR", quietly = TRUE) &&
    as_c2_key %in% names(profiles_list) &&
    as_c4_key %in% names(profiles_list)) {

  nmd  <- compute_subset_counts(profiles_list[[as_c2_key]])
  ctrl <- compute_subset_counts(profiles_list[[as_c4_key]])

  # After gene-matching, NMD and Control have the same number of pairs
  n_matched <- nmd$all
  stopifnot(nmd$all == ctrl$all)

  if (!is.null(nmd) && !is.null(ctrl)) {

    # Build PTC subdivision nodes and edges for terminal categories
    ptc_nodes <- ""
    ptc_edges <- ""
    ptc_rank_items <- c("FPTC", "FNPTC")

    # Same-start in-frame → PTC subdivision (if either has PTC > 0)
    if (nmd$if_ptc > 0 || ctrl$if_ptc > 0) {
      ptc_nodes <- paste0(ptc_nodes, sprintf('
  IFPTC  [label=<<b>Same Frame + PTC</b><br/>%s>, fillcolor="#fcbba1", color="#cb181d"]
  IFNPTC [label=<<b>Same Frame, No PTC</b><br/>%s>, fillcolor="#c6dbef", color="#3182bd"]
', dual(nmd$if_ptc, ctrl$if_ptc), dual(nmd$if_no_ptc, ctrl$if_no_ptc)))
      ptc_edges <- paste0(ptc_edges, "  IF -> IFPTC\n  IF -> IFNPTC\n")
      ptc_rank_items <- c(ptc_rank_items, "IFPTC", "IFNPTC")
    }
    # Diff-start same-frame → PTC subdivision
    if (nmd$sf_ptc > 0 || ctrl$sf_ptc > 0) {
      ptc_nodes <- paste0(ptc_nodes, sprintf('
  SFPTC  [label=<<b>Same Frame + PTC</b><br/>%s>, fillcolor="#fcbba1", color="#cb181d"]
  SFNPTC [label=<<b>Same Frame, No PTC</b><br/>%s>, fillcolor="#c6dbef", color="#3182bd"]
', dual(nmd$sf_ptc, ctrl$sf_ptc), dual(nmd$sf_no_ptc, ctrl$sf_no_ptc)))
      ptc_edges <- paste0(ptc_edges, "  FP -> SFPTC\n  FP -> SFNPTC\n")
      ptc_rank_items <- c(ptc_rank_items, "SFPTC", "SFNPTC")
    }
    # Diff-start diff-frame → PTC subdivision
    if (nmd$df_ptc > 0 || ctrl$df_ptc > 0) {
      ptc_nodes <- paste0(ptc_nodes, sprintf('
  DFPTC  [label=<<b>Diff Frame + PTC</b><br/>%s>, fillcolor="#fcbba1", color="#cb181d"]
  DFNPTC [label=<<b>Diff Frame, No PTC</b><br/>%s>, fillcolor="#c6dbef", color="#3182bd"]
', dual(nmd$df_ptc, ctrl$df_ptc), dual(nmd$df_no_ptc, ctrl$df_no_ptc)))
      ptc_edges <- paste0(ptc_edges, "  FD -> DFPTC\n  FD -> DFNPTC\n")
      ptc_rank_items <- c(ptc_rank_items, "DFPTC", "DFNPTC")
    }
    # Diff-start diff-frame + FS → PTC subdivision
    if (nmd$dfs_ptc > 0 || ctrl$dfs_ptc > 0) {
      ptc_nodes <- paste0(ptc_nodes, sprintf('
  DFSPTC  [label=<<b>Diff Frame + FS + PTC</b><br/>%s>, fillcolor="#fcbba1", color="#cb181d"]
  DFSNPTC [label=<<b>Diff Frame + FS, No PTC</b><br/>%s>, fillcolor="#c6dbef", color="#3182bd"]
', dual(nmd$dfs_ptc, ctrl$dfs_ptc), dual(nmd$dfs_no_ptc, ctrl$dfs_no_ptc)))
      ptc_edges <- paste0(ptc_edges, "  FDFS -> DFSPTC\n  FDFS -> DFSNPTC\n")
      ptc_rank_items <- c(ptc_rank_items, "DFSPTC", "DFSNPTC")
    }

    ptc_rank <- sprintf("  {rank=same; %s}", paste(ptc_rank_items, collapse = "; "))

    dot_combined <- sprintf('
digraph pair_subsets {
  graph [rankdir=TB, fontname="Helvetica", nodesep=0.6, ranksep=0.9,
         size="16,20", label=<<b>Pair Subset Overview (all_samples)</b><br/>
         <font color="#d95f0e">NMD (C2)</font> | <font color="#3182bd">Control (C4)</font>>,
         labelloc=t, labeljust=c, fontsize=24]
  node  [shape=box, style="rounded,filled", fontname="Helvetica", fontsize=20,
         margin="0.35,0.25", width=3.5]
  edge  [color="#666666", penwidth=2.0, fontname="Helvetica", fontsize=14]

  ALL [label=<<b>Gene-Matched Pairs</b><br/>%s pairs<br/><font point-size="16">(same genes, same references)</font>>,
       fillcolor="#e8f4f8", color="#2c7fb8"]

  COD [label=<<b>Both-Coding Pairs</b><br/>%s>,
       fillcolor="#c7e9c0", color="#31a354"]
  NC  [label=<<b>Non-Coding</b><br/>%s<br/><font point-size="15">(one/both lack CDS)</font>>,
       fillcolor="#f0f0f0", color="#999999"]

  SS  [label=<<b>Same Start Site</b><br/>%s>,
       fillcolor="#fff7bc", color="#d95f0e"]
  DS  [label=<<b>Different Start Site</b><br/>%s>,
       fillcolor="#fff7bc", color="#d95f0e"]
  NSC [label=<<b>No Shared CDS</b><br/>%s>,
       fillcolor="#f0f0f0", color="#999999"]

  IF  [label=<<b>Same Frame</b><br/>%s>,
       fillcolor="#c6dbef", color="#3182bd"]
  FS  [label=<<b>Frameshift</b><br/>%s>,
       fillcolor="#fcbba1", color="#cb181d"]
  FP  [label=<<b>Same Frame</b><br/>%s>,
       fillcolor="#c6dbef", color="#3182bd"]
  FD  [label=<<b>Diff Frame</b><br/>%s>,
       fillcolor="#fff7bc", color="#d95f0e"]
  FDFS [label=<<b>Diff Frame + FS</b><br/>%s>,
       fillcolor="#fcbba1", color="#cb181d"]

  FPTC  [label=<<b>Frameshift + PTC</b><br/>%s>,
         fillcolor="#fcbba1", color="#cb181d"]
  FNPTC [label=<<b>Frameshift, No PTC</b><br/>%s<br/><font point-size="15">(novel proteins)</font>>,
         fillcolor="#dadaeb", color="#6a51a3"]

  %s

  node [shape=plaintext, style="", fontsize=20, fontcolor="#555555"]

  A_ALL [label=<<b>Used by:</b> Event Frequency, Gain/Loss,<br/>IR, Divergence, Co-occurrence,<br/>Heterogeneity, Meta-analysis<br/><font point-size="17">(Sections 4-6)</font>>]
  A_COD [label=<<b>Used by:</b> PTC Rates,<br/>Frame Comparison<br/><font point-size="17">(Section 3)</font>>]
  A_SS  [label=<<b>Used by:</b> Splicing-Induced<br/>Frameshift Enrichment test<br/><font point-size="17">(Section 3)</font>>]
  A_FS  [label=<<b>Used by:</b> Frameshift Outcome,<br/>Frame-PTC Cross-Reference<br/><font point-size="17">(Section 3)</font>>]
  A_PTC [label=<<b>Used by:</b> PTC Distance vs logFC,<br/>GAM models<br/><font point-size="17">(Section 3)</font>>]
  A_NP  [label=<<b>Used by:</b> Novel Protein<br/>Analysis<br/><font point-size="17">(Section 3)</font>>]

  ALL -> COD
  ALL -> NC

  COD -> SS
  COD -> DS
  COD -> NSC

  SS -> IF
  SS -> FS

  DS -> FP
  DS -> FD
  DS -> FDFS

  FS -> FPTC
  FS -> FNPTC

  %s

  edge [style=dashed, color="#aaaaaa", penwidth=1.0, arrowhead=none]
  ALL -> A_ALL
  COD -> A_COD
  SS  -> A_SS
  FS  -> A_FS
  FPTC -> A_PTC
  FNPTC -> A_NP

  {rank=same; ALL; A_ALL}
  {rank=same; COD; NC; A_COD}
  {rank=same; SS; DS; NSC; A_SS}
  {rank=same; IF; FS; FP; FD; FDFS; A_FS}
  %s
}',
    fmt(n_matched),
    dual(nmd$coding, ctrl$coding),
    dual(nmd$non_coding, ctrl$non_coding),
    dual(nmd$same_start, ctrl$same_start),
    dual(nmd$diff_start, ctrl$diff_start),
    dual(nmd$no_shared_cds, ctrl$no_shared_cds),
    dual(nmd$ss_if, ctrl$ss_if),
    dual(nmd$ss_fs, ctrl$ss_fs),

    )
  }
}
```

```{r compute-all, include=FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# Silent compute chunk: all cached_compute() calls + comparePairSets
# No output — results stored in set_results / cross_results for display sections
# =============================================================================
set_results <- list()
cross_results <- list()

for (key in names(profiles_list)) {
  profiles <- profiles_list[[key]]
  message(sprintf("Computing analyses for %s...", key))

  prof_summary <- summarizeProfiles(profiles)
  divergence <- cached_compute(paste0("div_", key),
    tryCatch(quantifyPairDivergence(profiles, structures, cds), error = function(e) NULL))
  regional_impact <- cached_compute(paste0("ri_", key),
    tryCatch(quantifyRegionalImpact(profiles, annotated_ue, cds), error = function(e) NULL))
  cooc <- cached_compute(paste0("cooc_", key),
    tryCatch(testCooccurrence(profiles), error = function(e) NULL))
  event_regions <- cached_compute(paste0("er_", key),
    tryCatch(mapEventsToRegions(profiles, annotated_ue, cds), error = function(e) NULL))
  ptc_assoc <- cached_compute(paste0("ptc_", key),
    tryCatch(testPtcAssociation(ptc, profiles), error = function(e) NULL))
  frame_walk <- cached_compute(paste0("fw_", key),
    tryCatch(analyzeFrameWalk(profiles, cds, ptc), error = function(e) NULL))
  frame_comp <- cached_compute(paste0("fc_", key),
    tryCatch(compareIsoformFrames(profiles, cds_exons, cds), error = function(e) NULL))

  # Dependent computations (not cached separately — fast from cached event_regions)
  orf_bound <- NULL; orf_impact <- NULL
  if (!is.null(event_regions) && nrow(event_regions) > 0) {
    orf_bound <- tryCatch(testOrfBoundarySusceptibility(event_regions, annotated_ue),
                          error = function(e) NULL)
    orf_impact <- tryCatch(summarizeOrfImpact(event_regions, cds),
                           error = function(e) NULL)
  }

  set_results[[key]] <- list(
    profiles = profiles, prof_summary = prof_summary, divergence = divergence,
    regional_impact = regional_impact,
    cooc = cooc, event_regions = event_regions, orf_bound = orf_bound,
    orf_impact = orf_impact, ptc_assoc = ptc_assoc, frame_walk = frame_walk,
    frame_comp = frame_comp, evt_freq = compute_event_freq(profiles)
  )
}

# comparePairSets per cell type (cached, reused by display sections + meta-analysis)
# Include DD_ALI for the dedicated section (profiles loaded from limma data)
all_cts_for_cps <- unique(c(cell_types, ali_ct))
for (ct in all_cts_for_cps) {
  ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
  c2_key <- paste0("c2_", ct_label)
  c4_key <- paste0("c4_", ct_label)
  if (!c2_key %in% names(profiles_list) || !c4_key %in% names(profiles_list)) next

  message(sprintf("Computing NMD vs Control comparison for %s...", ct))
  ptc_c2 <- ptc[ptc$isoform_id %in% profiles_list[[c2_key]]$comparator_isoform_id, ]
  ptc_c4 <- ptc[ptc$isoform_id %in% profiles_list[[c4_key]]$comparator_isoform_id, ]

  cross_results[[ct]] <- cached_compute(
    paste0("cps_", ct_label),
    tryCatch(
      comparePairSets(profiles_list[[c2_key]], profiles_list[[c4_key]],
                       ptc_a = ptc_c2, ptc_b = ptc_c4,
                       paired = TRUE, verbose = FALSE),
      error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf("comparePairSets failed for %s: %s", ct, e$message))
        NULL
      }
    )
  )
}

# Cell types available for display (DD_ALI excluded — dedicated section below)
all_cts_with_profiles <- unique(c(cell_types, ali_ct))
display_cts <- setdiff(
  all_cts_with_profiles[sapply(all_cts_with_profiles, function(ct) {
    ct_label <- ct_to_label(ct)
    any(paste0(c("c2_", "c4_"), ct_label) %in% names(set_results))
  })],
  ali_ct
)
per_ct <- setdiff(display_cts, "all_samples")
c2_per_ct <- per_ct[sapply(per_ct, function(ct)
  paste0("c2_", ct_to_label(ct)) %in% names(set_results))]

# Main cell types for cross-CT analyses (excluding DD_ALI outlier)
main_per_ct <- intersect(c2_per_ct, main_cts)
ali_in_c2 <- ali_ct %in% c2_per_ct

message("All computations complete.")
```


# 3. Event Type Glossary {.tabset}

Isopair detects 12 structural event types organized into 4 categories. Each tab below
shows a schematic diagram of the event alongside its definition. In all diagrams, the
**Reference** (top) is the dominant non-NMD isoform and the **Comparator** (bottom) is
the isoform being compared. Events are always described from the comparator's perspective:
a **GAIN** means the comparator has additional sequence relative to the reference, and a
**LOSS** means the comparator is missing sequence present in the reference.

```{r sec4-glossary, results='asis', fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
if (has_ggplot2) {
  # Synthetic schematic helper — creates a simple pair plot for glossary
  glossary_plot <- function(ref_s, ref_e, comp_s, comp_e, title, subtitle,
                            ref_cds = NULL, comp_cds = NULL, events = NULL) {
    plot_ucsc_pair(ref_s, ref_e, comp_s, comp_e, strand = "+",
                   ref_cds = ref_cds, comp_cds = comp_cds,
                   ref_label = "Reference", comp_label = "Comparator",
                   events = events, title = title, subtitle = subtitle)
  }

  # ---- Terminal Events ----

  cat("## Alt_TSS\n\n")
  cat("**Alternative Transcription Start Site.** The two isoforms begin at different\n")
  cat("genomic positions. Detected when the 5'-most exon of one isoform does not overlap\n")
  cat("the 5'-most exon of the other. Direction: GAIN if the comparator's TSS is further\n")
  cat("upstream (extending the transcript); LOSS if it is further downstream (truncating it).\n\n")
  p <- glossary_plot(
    ref_s  = c(100, 400, 700), ref_e  = c(200, 550, 850),
    comp_s = c(250, 400, 700), comp_e = c(350, 550, 850),
    title = "Alt_TSS: Alternative Transcription Start Site",
    subtitle = "Comparator starts at a different position (here, downstream = LOSS)"
  )
  print(p); cat("\n\n")

  cat("## Alt_TES\n\n")
  cat("**Alternative Transcription End Site.** The two isoforms end at different\n")
  cat("genomic positions. Detected when the 3'-most exon of one isoform does not overlap\n")
  cat("the 3'-most exon of the other. Direction: GAIN if the comparator extends further;\n")
  cat("LOSS if it ends earlier.\n\n")
  p <- glossary_plot(
    ref_s  = c(100, 400, 700), ref_e  = c(200, 550, 900),
    comp_s = c(100, 400, 700), comp_e = c(200, 550, 800),
    title = "Alt_TES: Alternative Transcription End Site",
    subtitle = "Comparator ends earlier (LOSS)"
  )
  print(p); cat("\n\n")

  # ---- Boundary Events ----

  cat("## A5SS\n\n")
  cat("**Alternative 5' Splice Site.** An internal exon has a different 5' (donor)\n")
  cat("boundary between the two isoforms while sharing the same 3' boundary. The exon\n")
  cat("is extended or truncated at its 5' end. Direction: GAIN if the comparator's exon\n")
  cat("is longer; LOSS if shorter.\n\n")
  p <- glossary_plot(
    ref_s  = c(100, 400, 700), ref_e  = c(200, 550, 850),
    comp_s = c(100, 350, 700), comp_e = c(200, 550, 850),
    title = "A5SS: Alternative 5' Splice Site",
    subtitle = "Comparator exon extends further at its 5' end (GAIN)"
  )
  print(p); cat("\n\n")

  cat("## A3SS\n\n")
  cat("**Alternative 3' Splice Site.** An internal exon has a different 3' (acceptor)\n")
  cat("boundary between the two isoforms while sharing the same 5' boundary. The exon\n")
  cat("is extended or truncated at its 3' end. Direction: GAIN if the comparator's exon\n")
  cat("is longer; LOSS if shorter.\n\n")
  p <- glossary_plot(
    ref_s  = c(100, 400, 700), ref_e  = c(200, 550, 850),
    comp_s = c(100, 400, 700), comp_e = c(200, 600, 850),
    title = "A3SS: Alternative 3' Splice Site",
    subtitle = "Comparator exon extends further at its 3' end (GAIN)"
  )
  print(p); cat("\n\n")

  cat("## Partial_IR_5\n\n")
  cat("**Partial Intron Retention (5' end).** An intron is partially retained: one isoform's\n")
  cat("exon extends into the intron from its 5' side, covering what is intronic sequence in\n")
  cat("the other isoform. The 3' boundary of the retaining exon falls within the intron.\n")
  cat("Direction: GAIN if the comparator retains; LOSS if the reference retains.\n\n")
  p <- glossary_plot(
    ref_s  = c(100, 400, 700), ref_e  = c(200, 550, 850),
    comp_s = c(100, 400, 700), comp_e = c(200, 620, 850),
    title = "Partial_IR_5: Partial Intron Retention (5' side)",
    subtitle = "Comparator exon extends into the intron from the 5' end (GAIN)"
  )
  print(p); cat("\n\n")

  cat("## Partial_IR_3\n\n")
  cat("**Partial Intron Retention (3' end).** An intron is partially retained: one isoform's\n")
  cat("exon extends into the intron from its 3' side, covering what is intronic sequence in\n")
  cat("the other isoform. The 5' boundary of the retaining exon falls within the intron.\n")
  cat("Direction: GAIN if the comparator retains; LOSS if the reference retains.\n\n")
  p <- glossary_plot(
    ref_s  = c(100, 400, 700), ref_e  = c(200, 550, 850),
    comp_s = c(100, 400, 640), comp_e = c(200, 550, 850),
    title = "Partial_IR_3: Partial Intron Retention (3' side)",
    subtitle = "Comparator exon extends into the intron from the 3' end (GAIN)"
  )
  print(p); cat("\n\n")

  # ---- Exon-Level Events ----

  cat("## SE (Skipped Exon)\n\n")
  cat("**Skipped Exon.** An exon present in one isoform is completely absent from the\n")
  cat("other. The flanking exons splice directly to each other, skipping over the exon.\n")
  cat("Direction: GAIN if the comparator includes the exon (reference skips it);\n")
  cat("LOSS if the comparator skips it (reference includes it).\n\n")
  p <- glossary_plot(
    ref_s  = c(100, 400, 600, 800), ref_e  = c(200, 500, 700, 900),
    comp_s = c(100, 400, 800),       comp_e = c(200, 500, 900),
    title = "SE: Skipped Exon",
    subtitle = "Comparator skips an internal exon present in the reference (LOSS)"
  )
  print(p); cat("\n\n")

  cat("## Missing_Internal\n\n")
  cat("**Missing Internal Exon.** Similar to SE but arising from a multi-exon skip:\n")
  cat("one isoform is missing one or more internal exons that are present in the other.\n")
  cat("Often co-occurs with other Missing_Internal events from the same splice decision.\n")
  cat("Direction: GAIN if the comparator has the exon; LOSS if the comparator lacks it.\n\n")
  p <- glossary_plot(
    ref_s  = c(100, 350, 550, 750, 950), ref_e  = c(200, 450, 650, 850, 1050),
    comp_s = c(100, 950),                 comp_e = c(200, 1050),
    title = "Missing_Internal: Missing Internal Exon(s)",
    subtitle = "Comparator skips multiple internal exons (LOSS × 3)"
  )
  print(p); cat("\n\n")

  # ---- Intron Retention Events ----

  cat("## IR\n\n")
  cat("**Full Intron Retention.** One isoform has a single exon that spans the region\n")
  cat("covered by two or more exons (plus the intervening intron) in the other isoform.\n")
  cat("The retaining exon boundaries match exactly. This is a full retention where the\n")
  cat("entire intron is included in the retaining isoform's exon.\n")
  cat("Direction: GAIN if the comparator retains the intron; LOSS if the reference retains it.\n\n")
  p <- glossary_plot(
    ref_s  = c(100, 400, 700), ref_e  = c(200, 550, 850),
    comp_s = c(100, 400),       comp_e = c(200, 850),
    title = "IR: Full Intron Retention",
    subtitle = "Comparator retains the intron — single exon spans what are two exons + intron in ref (GAIN)"
  )
  print(p); cat("\n\n")

  cat("## IR_diff_5\n\n")
  cat("**Intron Retention with 5' Boundary Difference.** Like IR, but the retaining\n")
  cat("exon's 5' boundary differs from the first overlapping exon in the other isoform.\n")
  cat("The intron is retained, but the exon boundary is shifted at the 5' end.\n\n")
  p <- glossary_plot(
    ref_s  = c(100, 400, 700), ref_e  = c(200, 550, 850),
    comp_s = c(100, 370),       comp_e = c(200, 850),
    title = "IR_diff_5: Intron Retention with 5' Boundary Difference",
    subtitle = "Comparator retains the intron, but 5' boundary of retaining exon is shifted (GAIN)"
  )
  print(p); cat("\n\n")

  cat("## IR_diff_3\n\n")
  cat("**Intron Retention with 3' Boundary Difference.** Like IR, but the retaining\n")
  cat("exon's 3' boundary differs from the last overlapping exon in the other isoform.\n")
  cat("The intron is retained, but the exon boundary is shifted at the 3' end.\n\n")
  p <- glossary_plot(
    ref_s  = c(100, 400, 700), ref_e  = c(200, 550, 850),
    comp_s = c(100, 400),       comp_e = c(200, 880),
    title = "IR_diff_3: Intron Retention with 3' Boundary Difference",
    subtitle = "Comparator retains the intron, but 3' boundary of retaining exon is shifted (GAIN)"
  )
  print(p); cat("\n\n")

  cat("## IR_diff_5_3\n\n")
  cat("**Intron Retention with Both Boundary Differences.** Like IR, but both the 5'\n")
  cat("and 3' boundaries of the retaining exon differ from the flanking exons in the\n")
  cat("other isoform. The intron is retained but the exon boundaries are shifted at\n")
  cat("both ends.\n\n")
  p <- glossary_plot(
    ref_s  = c(100, 400, 700), ref_e  = c(200, 550, 850),
    comp_s = c(100, 370),       comp_e = c(200, 880),
    title = "IR_diff_5_3: Intron Retention with Both Boundary Differences",
    subtitle = "Comparator retains the intron with shifted boundaries at both ends (GAIN)"
  )
  print(p); cat("\n\n")
}
```

In the IR section of this report, **IR_diff** refers to the aggregate of IR_diff_5,
IR_diff_3, and IR_diff_5_3 events — intron retentions where exon boundaries do not
match exactly.

# 4. Structural Differences

At baseline, non-NMD isoform pairs share ~50--58% of their exonic sequence and differ by a
median of ~700--800bp. IR and terminal events are the most prevalent event types, and the
next-best (comparator) isoform is typically shorter than the dominant (positive net_bp). This
represents the natural structural diversity between co-expressed isoforms from the same gene.

## Event Frequency

Prevalence of each splicing event type, measured as the percentage of isoform pairs containing
at least one instance of that event. NMD and Control are compared using Fisher's exact test per event type.

**Columns:** **event_type** = splicing event; **NMD_n/Ctrl_n** = number of pairs with the event; **NMD_pct/Ctrl_pct** = % of pairs; **OR** = odds ratio (>1 = more prevalent in NMD); **adj_p** = BH-adjusted p-value; **direction** = which group is enriched.

```{r sec4-event-freq, results='asis', fig.height=8}
render_event_frequency("all_samples")
```

## Structural Divergence

Length differences between reference and comparator isoforms, broken down by transcript
region. All differences are computed directly from the isoform pair as
`reference_bp − comparator_bp`, so **positive values** mean the comparator is shorter
(lost sequence) and **negative values** mean the comparator is longer (gained sequence).
For 5' UTR, CDS, and 3' UTR rows, only pairs where both isoforms have >0 bp in that
region are included (n column).

**Columns:** **region** = transcript region; **NMD_n/Ctrl_n** = number of pairs with
data for that region; **NMD_median_diff/Ctrl_median_diff** = median bp difference
(ref − comp); **NMD_mean_diff/Ctrl_mean_diff** = mean bp difference (ref − comp);
**NMD_pct_comp_shorter/Ctrl_pct_comp_shorter** = % of pairs where the
comparator is shorter; **wilcox_p** = Wilcoxon rank-sum test comparing NMD vs Control
differences.

**Note:** Per-region medians do not sum to the Overall Exonic median for two reasons:
(1) the median is not an additive statistic, and (2) the 5' UTR, CDS, and 3' UTR rows
are each computed on a filtered subset of pairs where both isoforms have >0 bp in that
region (see n columns), whereas Overall Exonic uses all pairs. The mean columns are
provided as a complementary summary since means are additive on the same set of pairs,
though they are more sensitive to outliers.

```{r sec4-divergence, results='asis'}
div_rows <- compute_divergence_row("all_samples")
if (!is.null(div_rows)) {
  knitr::kable(div_rows, row.names = FALSE,
               caption = "Structural Divergence by Region: NMD vs Control") |> print()
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Gain/Loss Balance

Net base pair change between reference and comparator isoforms. Computed as
`net_bp = bp_loss - bp_gain`, where LOSS and GAIN are from the comparator's perspective.
**Positive net_bp** means the comparator has lost more sequence than it gained (comparator is
shorter than the reference). **Negative net_bp** means the comparator has gained more sequence
(comparator is longer than the reference).

**Columns:** **NMD_med_net_bp/Ctrl_med_net_bp** = median net bp change; **wilcox_p** = Wilcoxon rank-sum test; **cliffs_d** = Cliff's delta effect size.

```{r sec4-gain-loss, results='asis'}
gl_rows <- compute_gain_loss_row("all_samples")
if (!is.null(gl_rows)) {
  knitr::kable(gl_rows, caption = "Net BP Change: NMD vs Control") |> print()
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Gain/Loss Direction by Event Type

For each event type, the direction indicates whether the comparator has GAINED or LOST that
feature relative to the reference. GAIN means the comparator has additional sequence (e.g., an
extra exon); LOSS means the comparator is missing sequence present in the reference.

**Columns:** **NMD_gain/NMD_loss** = event counts by direction in NMD pairs; **NMD_pct_gain** = % of events that are gains; **Ctrl_gain/Ctrl_loss/Ctrl_pct_gain** = same for Control; **fisher_p** = Fisher's exact test; **adj_p** = BH-adjusted p-value.

```{r sec4-gain-loss-direction, results='asis'}
dir_comp <- compute_gain_loss_direction("all_samples")
if (!is.null(dir_comp)) {
  render_dt(dir_comp, caption = "Gain/Loss Direction: NMD vs Control — all_samples")
}
```

## Intron Retention Analysis

Intron retention (IR) is the most prevalent event type at baseline, making it the dominant
structural difference between co-expressed isoforms from the same gene. IR events are detected
when one isoform has a single exon that spans the region covered by two or more exons (plus
the intervening intron) in the other isoform. Long-read sequencing may capture more IR than
short-read studies, since retained introns extend transcript length and are difficult to
assemble from short reads.

This section examines IR events (including IR, IR_diff, Partial_IR_5, Partial_IR_3) in
detail. **Direction reminder:** A GAIN means the comparator isoform has *retained* an intron
that is spliced out in the reference; a LOSS means the comparator has *lost* a retained intron
present in the reference (i.e., the comparator splices it out).

### IR Event Direction: Individual Types

GAIN/LOSS breakdown for each IR-family event type, stratified by NMD and Control.

```{r sec4-ir-individual, results='asis'}
ir_types <- c("IR", "IR_diff", "Partial_IR_5", "Partial_IR_3")

ir_detail <- compute_ir_individual("all_samples")
if (!is.null(ir_detail)) {
  knitr::kable(ir_detail,
               caption = "IR Event Direction: NMD vs Control — all_samples") |> print()
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

### Cumulative IR Burden

Total IR-family events (IR + IR_diff + Partial_IR_5 + Partial_IR_3) aggregated across all
subtypes, comparing NMD and Control. This measures the overall intron retention burden
per pair and whether the direction (GAIN vs LOSS) differs between comparison groups.

```{r sec4-ir-cumulative, results='asis', fig.height=8}
ir_cumul_rows <- compute_ir_cumulative_row("all_samples")

if (!is.null(ir_cumul_rows)) {
  cat("**Columns:** **NMD_total_ir/Ctrl_total_ir** = total IR-family events; ")
  cat("**NMD_per_pair/Ctrl_per_pair** = mean IR events per isoform pair; ")
  cat("**NMD_pct_gain/Ctrl_pct_gain** = % of IR events that are GAINs (comparator retains intron); ")
  cat("**count_wilcox_p** = Wilcoxon test on per-pair IR event counts (NMD vs Control); ")
  cat("**dir_fisher_p** = Fisher's exact test on GAIN vs LOSS proportions.\n\n")
  knitr::kable(ir_cumul_rows, caption = "Cumulative IR Burden: NMD vs Control") |> print()
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Distribution Plots

```{r sec4-dist-plots, results='asis', fig.height=6}
if (has_ggplot2) {
  # pct_shared from divergence — all_samples only
  pct_shared_data <- {
    rows <- list()
    for (comp in c("c2", "c4")) {
      key <- paste0(comp, "_allsamples")
      if (!key %in% names(set_results)) next

    }
```
